Actor.description: Pseudonymous reference to the principal that performed or requested an operation (Clarification 8: no email, display name or other free-text identity field). Used by ActionIntent, ApprovalDecision and AuditRecord. Derived server-side from validated identity; never taken from a request body or model output.
Actor.title: Actor

Agent.description: AI agent as a logical, versioned catalog entity; concrete releases are AgentVersion. Python validators: validate_canonical_id_fullmatch (Python re.search lets '$' match before a trailing newline; the suite re-checks every canonical ID with re.fullmatch), validate_customer_segment_matches (customer segment of every canonical ID equals customer_id), validate_timestamp_order (created_at <= updated_at).
Agent.title: Agent

AgentVersion.description: Immutable release of an Agent (instructions, tools and model bindings at a point in time). Python validators: validate_canonical_id_fullmatch (Python re.search lets '$' match before a trailing newline; the suite re-checks every canonical ID with re.fullmatch), validate_customer_segment_matches (customer segment of every canonical ID equals customer_id), validate_timestamp_order (created_at <= updated_at).
AgentVersion.title: AgentVersion

AuditRecord.description: Append-only, hash-chained audit evidence (PRP.md section 3, PRD NS-06 'audit before/after'). Kinds: `before` (target state captured before a change), `after` (outcome and target state after), `denied` (a query, tool, export, push or action that authorization or policy refused). There is no update-capable field: no updated_at, modified_by, etag, version, status or deleted flag; corrections are new records. previous_hash is required for every record except the chain head (sequence 0), where it is null. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are checked by `validate_audit_chain` in tests/contracts/test_schemas.py: record_hash equals sha256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form of the record without record_hash; within a chain_id, sequence is contiguous from 0 and each previous_hash equals the preceding record's record_hash.
AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord

Budget.description: Shared bounded-execution budget for every query, traversal, search, export and viewport expansion (PRP-01 clarification 15; NS-05, NS-06). timeout_ms, limit and max_depth are mandatory. The maxima here are contract ceilings; the server may clamp to lower policy values and reports the effective values and any truncation in Page. Not a standalone document, so it carries no schema_version.
Budget.title: Budget

ChainVerification.description: Result of verifying one chain. ``first_invalid_index`` is a position in the input.
ChainVerification.title: ChainVerification

CostImplication.description: Plan/cost implication of the decision. Unknown is null, never 0; an estimate cites its price version.
CostImplication.title: CostImplication

Coverage.description: How much of the relevant population the evidence observed. observed_fraction null means unknown, never 0.
Coverage.title: Coverage

Curation.description: Latest steward decision on an edge (full history lives in the audit log).
Curation.title: Curation

DecisionResult.description: A stored steward decision and the presented edge after it.
DecisionResult.title: DecisionResult

DeploymentManifest.description: One customer-hosted NeuroSphere deployment plan (NS-07): a single cloud, approved regions, hosting profile, analytics backend and a reuse/create/skip decision per service with owner consent and cost implication. cloud is one scalar per manifest and no service, region or endpoint field can name another cloud, so routing Government data to Commercial is not expressible; Government manifests may list only usgov*/usdod* regions and Commercial manifests may not list them. Whether a backend, SKU or service is actually offered in the chosen cloud/region is decided by the capability matrix (CapabilityMatrixEntry, data in PRP-02), not by this schema. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are checked by the Python validator check_deployment_manifest in tests/contracts/test_deployment_manifest.py (PRP-01 item 7): each service appears at most once in services; existing_resource_id is not repeated across services.
DeploymentManifest.title: DeploymentManifest

DeploymentProfile.description: What the operator asks for at deployment (PRD NS-07).
DeploymentProfile.title: DeploymentProfile

Domain.description: Governance domain: the authorization and federation scope unit. Python validators: validate_canonical_id_fullmatch (Python re.search lets '$' match before a trailing newline; the suite re-checks every canonical ID with re.fullmatch), validate_customer_segment_matches (customer segment of every canonical ID equals customer_id), validate_timestamp_order (created_at <= updated_at).
Domain.title: Domain

EdgeFilter.description: Allowlisted edge filters, combined with AND.
EdgeFilter.title: EdgeFilter

EdgeObservation.description:
One raw observation of an edge, stored apart from the (curated) edge document.

``id`` is deterministic for the same input so replays are idempotent. Observations are
queryable by Auditor scope only; the presented lineage never depends on them directly.
EdgeObservation.title: EdgeObservation

EdgeOverride-Input.description: Steward decision on one edge (accept, reject, override, lock, unlock), applied with optimistic concurrency. The schema has no field that removes or replaces evidence_ids or security_evidence_ids, so an override cannot erase security evidence; observed facts are retained and the lock changes presented lineage only. lock and override decisions require a lock with locked=true, reason, expiry and actor. Python validators: validate_override_preserves_security_evidence, validate_customer_segment_matches, validate_override_relation_matches_edge (relation_type equals the type segment of edge_id), validate_lock_expiry_after_decision.
EdgeOverride-Input.title: EdgeOverride

EdgeOverride-Output.description: Steward decision on one edge (accept, reject, override, lock, unlock), applied with optimistic concurrency. The schema has no field that removes or replaces evidence_ids or security_evidence_ids, so an override cannot erase security evidence; observed facts are retained and the lock changes presented lineage only. lock and override decisions require a lock with locked=true, reason, expiry and actor. Python validators: validate_override_preserves_security_evidence, validate_customer_segment_matches, validate_override_relation_matches_edge (relation_type equals the type segment of edge_id), validate_lock_expiry_after_decision.
EdgeOverride-Output.title: EdgeOverride

EntityFilter.description: Allowlisted entity filters, combined with AND. They can only narrow the scope.
EntityFilter.title: EntityFilter

ExportPage.description: One page of the scope-filtered export. Page through ``next_cursor``.
ExportPage.title: ExportPage

FeatureRequest.description: An optional feature the deployment wants (for example a Foundry model or CMK).
FeatureRequest.title: FeatureRequest

GraphPath.description: One impact path: alternating node and edge IDs (``len(node_ids) == len(edge_ids)+1``).
GraphPath.title: GraphPath

GraphResult.description:
A bounded, scope-filtered subgraph.

``truncated`` is True when a budget stopped the walk early; the result is then partial
and must be labelled as such. Out-of-scope nodes never appear, not even as path
intermediates.
GraphResult.title: GraphResult

GraphSearchRequest.description: Term plus allowlisted entity filter plus mandatory budget.
GraphSearchRequest.title: GraphSearchRequest

GroundingSource.description: GroundingSource/DataAsset: a data asset read, written or used for grounding (index, store, table, file share, knowledge base). One schema covers both names. Python validators: validate_canonical_id_fullmatch (Python re.search lets '$' match before a trailing newline; the suite re-checks every canonical ID with re.fullmatch), validate_customer_segment_matches (customer segment of every canonical ID equals customer_id), validate_timestamp_order (created_at <= updated_at).
GroundingSource.title: GroundingSource

ImportRequest.description: A bounded batch of entity documents. ``dry_run`` validates and reports, writing nothing.
ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest

ImportResult.description:
Per-item outcome. ``committed`` is True only when every item was created.

Validation is all-or-report: when any item is ``rejected`` nothing is written. A failure
while writing (a race the validation could not see) marks that item ``failed`` and the rest
``skipped``; items already ``created`` stay created and are listed.
ImportResult.title: ImportResult

IngestResult.description: 202 body. Counts and reason codes only; never payload values.
IngestResult.title: IngestResult

LineageImpactRequest.description: Bounded impact paths (downstream = edges out) in the presented lineage.
LineageImpactRequest.title: LineageImpactRequest

LineageNeighborsRequest.description: Neighbors of one node in the presented lineage, bounded by ``budget``.
LineageNeighborsRequest.title: LineageNeighborsRequest

Lock-Input.description: Steward lock. Locks change presented lineage, never retained observations; re-inference must respect them. A lock (locked=true) requires reason, expiry and actor. Python validator validate_lock_expiry_after_decision enforces expiry later than the decision time.
Lock-Input.title: Lock

Lock-Output.description: Steward lock. Locks change presented lineage, never retained observations; re-inference must respect them. A lock (locked=true) requires reason, expiry and actor. Python validator validate_lock_expiry_after_decision enforces expiry later than the decision time.
Lock-Output.title: Lock

ModelDeployment.description: Deployed model endpoint with version, modality, context, tool capability and price reference. Unknown capabilities are null, never 0. Python validators: validate_canonical_id_fullmatch (Python re.search lets '$' match before a trailing newline; the suite re-checks every canonical ID with re.fullmatch), validate_customer_segment_matches (customer segment of every canonical ID equals customer_id), validate_timestamp_order (created_at <= updated_at).
ModelDeployment.title: ModelDeployment

OwnerConsent.description: Enterprise owner consent for using a (shared) resource. Always required for reuse.
OwnerConsent.title: OwnerConsent

OwnerConsentRecord.description:
Enterprise-owner consent to reuse specific shared resources.

A *granted* record must name a pseudonymous owner principal; it only ever covers the
resource ids it lists (ARM ids compare case-insensitively).
OwnerConsentRecord.title: OwnerConsentRecord

Page_Union_Person__Agent__AgentVersion__.title: Page[Union[Person, Agent, AgentVersion, ModelDeployment, GroundingSource, Tool, Service, Domain, Owner, Policy, RecommendationReference, RunReference]]

Person.description: Person as a pseudonymous principal only. There is deliberately no email, name, UPN, display_name, free-text or attributes field; re-identification is a policy-store concern, not a contract field. The id segment of the canonical ID is the pseudonym. Python validators: validate_canonical_id_fullmatch (Python re.search lets '$' match before a trailing newline; the suite re-checks every canonical ID with re.fullmatch), validate_customer_segment_matches (customer segment of every canonical ID equals customer_id), validate_timestamp_order (created_at <= updated_at), validate_person_id_is_pseudonym (id segment equals principal_pseudonym).
Person.title: Person

PlanCost.description: Mirrors the manifest ``cost_implication``; unknown is ``None``, never ``0``.
PlanCost.title: PlanCost

PlanRequest.description:
Everything the planner needs; the planner itself makes no ARM or HTTP call.

``scan`` is the :class:`ScanResponse` of a prior consented scan (passed in rather than
re-fetched, so the plan is a pure function of its inputs). Services without a choice
default to ``reuse`` when a discovered candidate exists, else ``create``.
PlanRequest.title: PlanRequest

Policy.description: Governance policy applied to catalog entities (access, data handling, model usage, cost). Python validators: validate_canonical_id_fullmatch (Python re.search lets '$' match before a trailing newline; the suite re-checks every canonical ID with re.fullmatch), validate_customer_segment_matches (customer segment of every canonical ID equals customer_id), validate_timestamp_order (created_at <= updated_at).
Policy.title: Policy

Prerequisite.description: A precondition for acting on the recommendation (NS-03: compatibility, quality regression, cost comparison, staged rollout, rollback).
Prerequisite.title: Prerequisite

PresentedEdge.description:
An edge as shown to users: observed facts after curation (locks, overrides, rejects).

Evidence and security evidence are always the full union (observed plus anything a
steward added); they are never reduced by a decision. ``hidden`` is True when a curated
reject hides the edge from presented lineage (Auditors can still see it).
PresentedEdge.title: PresentedEdge

PriceReference.description: Price sheet reference used for estimates; null when unpriced.
PriceReference.title: PriceReference

PriceTable.description: Versioned static price input. No live pricing call is ever made.
PriceTable.title: PriceTable

ProjectedEstimate.description: Projected cost effect. Always an estimate, always cites price_version (estimated spend without a price version is invalid, matching CostRecord).
ProjectedEstimate.title: ProjectedEstimate

Provenance.description: Where an edge or alias came from.
Provenance.title: Provenance

RecertifyRequest.description: Record a recertification of an owner; it is valid for ``valid_for_days`` from now.
RecertifyRequest.title: RecertifyRequest

Recommendation.description: An evidence-backed suggestion (NS-03): kind, evidence window, coverage, uncertainty, prerequisites, projected estimate and owner. Recommendations are insights, not actions: executing one goes through the shared action executor (schemas/actions/v1). Cold start uses bounded rules rather than fabricated scores: when evidence_status is insufficient_evidence, score must be absent; when score is absent, evidence_status must be insufficient_evidence. A projected_estimate always cites price_version. candidate_duplicate is always advisory (consolidation review, never an automatic merge). Unknown numeric values are null, never 0. Rules JSON Schema cannot express: evidence_window.start < evidence_window.end (tests/contracts/validators.py::check_time_range_order); uncertainty.lower <= score <= uncertainty.upper when both present (tests/contracts/validators.py::check_recommendation_score_interval); every subject_ids and owner_id belongs to the same cloud and customer as the document (tests/contracts/validators.py::check_recommendation_same_boundary).
Recommendation.title: Recommendation

RecommendationReference.description: Recommendation in reference form for the catalog graph. The full document is the recommendations/v1 contract; this node only points at it and its subjects. Python validators: validate_canonical_id_fullmatch (Python re.search lets '$' match before a trailing newline; the suite re-checks every canonical ID with re.fullmatch), validate_customer_segment_matches (customer segment of every canonical ID equals customer_id), validate_timestamp_order (created_at <= updated_at).
RecommendationReference.title: RecommendationReference

ReviewRequestBody.description: Only the recommendation id is read; ``domain_id``/``customer_id`` in the body are ignored.
ReviewRequestBody.title: ReviewRequestBody

RunReference.description: Pointer to a run held in the telemetry store. Runs and spans are referenced, never replicated into the graph; no prompt or response body appears here. Python validators: validate_canonical_id_fullmatch (Python re.search lets '$' match before a trailing newline; the suite re-checks every canonical ID with re.fullmatch), validate_customer_segment_matches (customer segment of every canonical ID equals customer_id), validate_timestamp_order (created_at <= updated_at).
RunReference.title: RunReference

ScanRequest.description: ``consent`` is optional in the schema so a missing record is a 403, not a 422.
ScanRequest.title: ScanRequest

visibility_note.default: Results reflect only what the calling identity can read. A subscription reported not_visible may still contain resources; absence of results is not absence of resources.
visibility_note.title: Visibility Note

Service.description: Service an agent or tool depends on (Azure service, SaaS, internal API, gateway). Service.title: Service

StaleAgentPlan.description:
Dry-run result. Nothing was changed. Send ``plan_id``, ``as_of``, ``window_days`` and the
``candidates`` back to confirm; the server re-derives the set and refuses any difference.
StaleAgentPlan.title: StaleAgentPlan

StaleAgentRequest.description: Dry-run: agents with no observation (edge ``last_observed``) within ``window_days``.
StaleAgentRequest.title: StaleAgentRequest

TargetRef.description: Reference to the resource an action changes or an audit record concerns. `canonical_id` uses the catalog grammar `cloud:customer:source:type:id` (Clarification 7); the pattern here mirrors it and the catalog/v1 grammar is authoritative. Python validator `validate_target_ref_matches_catalog_grammar` in tests/contracts/test_canonical_ids.py checks this pattern against the catalog ID corpus so the two cannot drift. The version being acted on is carried beside this object (ActionIntent.target_version), not inside it, so it is hashed as its own field.
TargetRef.title: TargetRef

Tool.description: Callable tool exposed to agents (function, API, MCP tool, search, code interpreter). Tool.title: Tool

Uncertainty.description: Uncertainty of the score or estimate. not_estimable is the honest value on cold start; it carries no bounds.

UnknownRemainder.description: A count of ledger entries whose amount is unknown (their money value is unknowable).
UnknownRemainder.title: UnknownRemainder
